probes.stdout:
ThreadScope: deterministic instrumented scenarios
  threadscope run <scenario> [--schedule 0,1,0,1] [--trace FILE]
  threadscope explore <scenario> --max-schedules N --max-steps N [--out DIR] [--all-traces]
  threadscope replay FILE
  threadscope branch FILE --step N --thread ID [--trace NEW_FILE]
Branch verifies the original, preserves choices before step N, then selects ID.
Run/branch suffix policy: always select the lowest runnable thread ID.
Run/explore limits: --max-steps N --timeout-ms N
Defaults: lost-update, 100 schedules, 1000 steps, 1000 ms per schedule.
Compatibility aliases: --max-runs, --fixed (lost-update-rmw).
Exit codes: 0 completed/no failures; 1 assertion/deadlock found; 2 error or incomplete run/search.
Scenarios:
  lost-update: Separate atomic loads/stores can lose an increment.
  lost-update-rmw: Atomic fetch_add preserves both increments.
  mutex-deadlock: Opposite lock orders can form a wait-for cycle.
  mutex-ordered: Both workers acquire first, then second.
